**Blocking (1): The pull request title is run as shell code in CI**

`${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}` is expanded into the script before the shell parses it, so a title such as `"; curl …| sh; echo "` runs arbitrary commands on the runner with this job's token. Pass it through an environment variable instead; the shell then treats it as data.

```suggestion
      - name: Greet
        env:
          TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
        run: |
          echo "Testing $TITLE"
```

**Blocking (2): `shell=True` runs the name argument as a command**

`widgets 'x; rm -rf ~'` runs `rm -rf ~`: the f-string puts the argument into a shell command line. Pass a list and let `subprocess` quote nothing. `check=True` also makes a failed fetch visible instead of printing the greeting anyway.

```suggestion
        subprocess.run(["widget-fetch", args.name], check=True)
```

**Should fix (3): Every retry runs even after a fetch succeeds**

The loop has no exit, so the default `--retries 3` fetches three times on every call. Stop after the first success, and re-raise the last error once the attempts are used up.

**Optional (5): Note the removal of `db/legacy.sql` in the changelog**

The file was the only record of how the old table was dropped. One line in `CHANGELOG.md` keeps that history findable.

**Nit (7): `attempt` is never used**

Name the loop variable `_`, as the rest of the package does.

```suggestion
    for _ in range(args.retries):
```
